77370.subject: ⚖️ SEC steps in to save crypto regulation
77370.body:
Today’s newsletter is brought to you by **[Choose Rich Live](https://www.youtube.com/@chooserichnick/streams)**[!](https://www.youtube.com/@chooserichnick/streams)

Our very own Nick O’Neill is has launched a new stream covering crypto, finance, AI, tech, and the stories shaping the internet economy.

If you already follow Nick, you know what to expect: sharp takes, market chaos, founder brain, and the occasional banger you’ll see clipped on the timeline five minutes later.

Episodes will be streaming live on YouTube, so make sure you’re subscribed to catch the next one as it happens.

**[Subscribe to Choose Rich Live!](https://www.youtube.com/@chooserichnick/streams)**

———————————————————————————

## Top Stories

**BTC** $64,107 (-0.2%) | **ETH** $1,911 (1.3%) | **SOL** $77 (0.9%)

* Equities and crypto pull back ahead of [today’s CPI print](https://x.com/DeItaone/status/2087506303627202765?s=20) — CPI comes in [at expectations](https://x.com/KobeissiLetter/status/2087517990828810660?s=20) and odds of a rate hike in September [fall](https://polymarket.com/event/fed-decision-in-september-762)

* Trump discusses [lowering capital gains tax](https://x.com/KobeissiLetter/status/2087337751880380822?s=20)

* SEC renews plans for [crypto regulation policies](https://decrypt.co/375375/sec-prepares-escape-hatch-securities-registration-crypto-projects) amidst Senate delays for the CLARITY Act— CFTC has [similar plans](https://x.com/WatcherGuru/status/2087232342905536833)

* Strategy to resume buying BTC after [7 week pause](https://x.com/Cointelegraph/status/2087247937759850960?s=20)

* OpenAI COO [Brad Lightcap leaves](https://x.com/Cointelegraph/status/2087222856618770896?s=20) for new project — Only OpenAI [ethicist ](https://decrypt.co/375315/openais-only-dedicated-ethicist-has-left-with-no-replacement-ft)leaves as well with no replacement

* Cognition looks to raise $1B at a [$40B+ valuation](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-08-12/ai-startup-cognition-in-new-funding-talks-at-40-billion-value), up from $26B in May

* DayOne files for a [$5B IPO](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-08-11/dayone-data-centers-said-to-confidentially-file-for-5-billion-ipo-us)

* CFTC uses [emergency authority](https://www.coindesk.com/policy/2026/08/11/cftc-orders-kalshi-to-continue-offering-prediction-markets-in-new-york-after-state-lawsuit) to allow Kalshi to continue operating in New York — Kalshi tops $4B annualized revenue and seeks investment at a [$40B valuation](https://www.theinformation.com/articles/kalshi-tops-4-billion-annualized-revenue-seeks-40-billion-valuation)

* CFTC charges Christopher Delgado over [$397M crypto ponzi](https://x.com/solidintel_x/status/2087293290961846547?s=20)

* Nvidia reveals [Nemotron 4](https://x.com/Cointelegraph/status/2087178219132735696) open-source AI mode

* xAI debuts[ AI teammate](https://x.com/bot/status/2087224798078517251) feature for Grok

77364.subject: Compute is an Asset Class now, and NVIDIA is the Bank of AI 🤖🏦; Grok Bot: SpaceXAI bets on agent operating syste…
77364.body:
View this post on the web at https://linas.substack.com/p/fintechpulse1112

Hey Everyone,
Good morning & happy Wednesday! Today, we’re diving into NVIDIA, which just convinced six of Wall Street's biggest names to turn compute into an asset class and itself into the bank of AI (what the $500B financing deal with Apollo, Blackstone, BlackRock, Brookfield, Goldman Sachs & KKR actually is, why $NVDA  fell on the news, & one thing nobody added up yet + a bonus deep dives into The AI Monopoly Playbook [ https://substack.com/redirect/e27b4fb3-b9bb-4e1c-8b6e-e0417bdeebe4?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] Nvidia is now running at a scale, and Who Actually Makes Money When AI Eats the World [ https://substack.com/redirect/763e6f44-a6ce-4972-a5ee-2bf67be37913?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] inside), and Grok Bot, SpaceXAI's new AI agent OS that drives the UI like a human employee would (what Grok Bot actually is, how it stacks up against OpenAI's ChatGPT Work, Anthropic's Claude Cowork [ https://substack.com/redirect/f70c7085-10bc-40f6-8be3-3e729e5a6785?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] & Google's Gemini Spark, and what this means for the future of AI + bonus deep dives into Y Combinators Open-Source AI Agent Harness [ https://substack.com/redirect/5454887a-66a6-4028-9065-82ec8f248f6e?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ], and How to Build an Agentic OS with Claude Fable 5 [ https://substack.com/redirect/7f75e3e4-67e8-4566-85cf-7c813429037e?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] inside). So let’s just jump straight into the fascinating stuff 🌶️
Compute is an Asset Class now, and NVIDIA is the Bank of AI 🤖🏦
The BIG News 🗞️ $5.26 trillion tech giant Nvidia’s $NVDA  $500 billion new financing agreement with Apollo, Blackstone, BlackRock, Brookfield, Goldman Sachs and KKR turns GPUs into loan collateral for the AI build-out, and the price of Wall Street’s participation is that Nvidia must guarantee what its own chips will be worth secondhand.
Jensen Huang just agreed to those terms, which makes the world’s most valuable chipmaker something closer to a bank than a semiconductor company 👀
